(5) Maintains a ResearchGate research profile. notes: IMPORTANT PATTERN TRAP FOUND ON THIS ROW - read before doing later Rainbow rows. The source list names her 'Dr. Sri Phani Bhargavi Dhulipudi', but her official Rainbow URL and page title DROP the surname and use an initial instead: 'Dr. D. Sri Phani Bhargavi', slug 'dr-d-sri-phani-bhargavi-pediatrician'. Worse, the specialty suffix in the slug is 'PEDIATRICIAN', not 'pediatric-cardiologist', even though the page title reads 'Best Pediatric Cardiologist in Hyderabad | Rainbow Children's Heart Institute'. So the Rainbow specialty slug is NOT reliably the doctor's sub-specialty - trust the page TITLE over the slug, and search by given names as well as surname. Identity is nonetheless confident, matched on four facts: given-name string 'Sri Phani Bhargavi' + specialty (paediatric cardiology) + hospital (Rainbow) + city, with the surname 'Dhulipudi' independently tying the two name forms together via her ResearchGate profile ('Bhargavi DHULIPUDI | Consultant Pediatric cardiologist | Dnb fnb | Rainbow Children's Hospital and Perinatal Care, Hyderabad') and via Skedoc, Vaidam, HexaHealth and Alafiya, which carry both forms. No rival same-name clinician exists - the four-part name is highly distinctive. BRANCH NOTE: the source row says Banjara Hills; the Rainbow URL branch segment is 'rchi', which is the RAINBOW CHILDREN'S HEART INSTITUTE - a distinct unit that is physically AT Banjara Hills (its centre page is /our-centre/hyderabad/rchi and Vaidam titles it 'Rainbow Children's Heart Institute, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad'). So 'rchi' is a unit slug occupying the branch position, not a contradiction of the source row. Expect other Rainbow unit slugs in that position on later rows. Band is Medium: only ONE official domain carries her (rainbowhospitals.in). ResearchGate, Vaidam, Skedoc, HexaHealth, CardiologistIndia, GlobalCareHealth, Shinon and Alafiya are all corroborating-only. One caution flagged for a human: banglahealthconnect.com titles her 'Consultant - Pediatric Cardiologist ... in Apollo Hyderabad'. That is a single low-quality aggregator contradicted by the official Rainbow page and by her own ResearchGate affiliation, so it was NOT recorded as an affiliation; it may reflect a stale or mis-tagged record. NO EMAIL OR PHONE RECORDED: Rainbow publishes no per-doctor contact details, and Rainbow branch numbers that appeared in a WebSearch synthesised summary failed the mandatory exact-phrase re-check ('"9676838787"' returned only pages about the unrelated UH Rainbow Babies & Children's Hospital, Cleveland, Ohio) and were discarded. The single most useful institutional route on this row is the dedicated RCHI contact page https://www.rainbowhospitals.in/rchi/contact , which a human with browser access should open - a unit-level contact page is far more targeted than the group helpline. RAINBOW URL PATTERN: /all/doctor/<city>/<branch-or-unit-slug>/<facility-type-slug>/dr-<name-slug>-<specialty-slug>, encoding both branch/unit and (unreliably) specialty; note this row's facility-type segment is 'pediatric-hospital' whereas the other four Rainbow rows in this batch use 'children-care-hospital'.
